label: r4c3
name: Deep trunk + mask + anti-collapse
hypothesis: A residual trunk of four 3x3 convs (9x9 receptive field), the legality mask as input, and a 3x3 local logit head that can learn anchor shifts. Recipe: 3 epochs, gamma 0.9, lambda 0.85, entropy 0.02, and a DONE head that starts at zero with an offset of minus 2. This tests the anti-collapse idea on a network with more context and the misalignment hedges. Refuted if it stays at 0 while the other anti-collapse candidates score.
